title: Persistent acid reflux, heartburn could be sign of esophageal cancer

Newsroom


# Persistent acid reflux, heartburn could be sign of esophageal cancer


April 18, 2024


Tens of millions of Americans suffer from chronic heartburn and acid reflux and it could be a sign of something far more serious.
